description: Required/optional field schema for Nigerian tailoring/fashion SMEs.

required_fields.label: Garment Type
clarifying_question_templates: What type of outfit are you looking to have made?

required_fields.label: Quantity
clarifying_question_templates: How many pieces are you ordering?

required_fields.label: Delivery Date
clarifying_question_templates: When do you need the outfit(s) ready by?

required_fields.label: Fabric Supplied by Client
clarifying_question_templates: Will you be supplying the fabric, or should we source it for you?

optional_fields.label: Style / Design Preference
clarifying_question_templates: Do you have a specific style or design in mind?

optional_fields.label: Embroidery / Embellishment
clarifying_question_templates: Will you need embroidery or any embellishments?

field_completeness_rules.notes: All required fields must be present before a quote can be computed.
